insight_q01: 473 accounts signed up in Q3 2025, giving Growth a clean quarter-over-quarter signup baseline to track pipeline volume against.
insight_q02: Overall trial activation rate is 55.9% -- just over half of signups complete onboarding and take a first meaningful action, leaving a substantial 'signed up but never activated' segment worth a dedicated re-engagement flow.
insight_q03: Referral converts to paid at 30.4%, nearly 3x Paid Search's 11.35% -- the same quality-over-volume pattern seen in retention data generally, and a strong argument for investing further in referral mechanics before scaling paid spend.
insight_q04: Current total MRR is $220,117.23 across all active paid accounts -- the core top-line number for any growth or board update.
insight_q05: Starter plan churns at 23.18%, roughly 8x Enterprise's 2.88% -- consistent with Starter's lower switching cost and typically lower product lock-in; Enterprise's low churn reflects deeper integration and likely annual contracts.
insight_q06: task_board (1,567 accounts) and team_chat (1,216) are the clear core-usage features; automation_rules and integrations sit in the middle of the adoption curve at ~590-640 accounts, making them reasonable 'next feature to drive adoption of' candidates for expansion campaigns.
insight_q09: Average MRR scales sharply by plan -- Enterprise at $1,483.77 vs. Growth's $252.28 and Starter's $30.10 -- meaning a single Enterprise upgrade is worth roughly 6 Growth-tier upgrades in MRR terms.
insight_q10: Only 35.4% of paid accounts are on annual billing -- given annual accounts show materially lower churn (see the plan-tier churn breakdown), a targeted annual-upgrade campaign for existing Monthly accounts is a concrete, low-risk retention lever.
insight_q12: 95 accounts fall in the 1000+ employee bracket -- a small but likely high-value segment worth checking against actual plan tier and MRR to see how well 'large company' correlates with 'Enterprise plan revenue' in practice.
insight_q15: E-commerce leads all industries in paid conversion at 22.88%, making it a natural vertical to prioritize in outbound/content targeting given it already converts self-serve traffic better than the account base average.
insight_q17: Feature-usage event volume has grown steadily every month from 119 (Apr 2024) to nearly 1,000/month by September 2024, tracking the growing active-account base -- a healthy usage-growth trend worth confirming continues in more recent months.
insight_q18: Product Hunt/Community-acquired accounts carry the highest average MRR per converted account ($454.83) -- somewhat counterintuitive for a typically bottom-of-funnel channel, and worth a follow-up look at whether this reflects a specific launch cohort or a durable pattern before reallocating budget toward it.
